name: Invincible Vs.: Battle Beast - Invincible Universe Skin
summary:
Relive the legendary brutality of the Scourge of the Twin Galaxies with the Invincible Universe Skin for Battle Beast. Ripped straight from the pages of the runaway hit comic series, this skin brings to life his iconic look from the first issue in meticulous detail. Step into the arena adorned in the classic, battle-worn armor and tattered cloak, wielding a custom circular mace from Battle Beast’s victory in the Blood Games.

Prove your strength. Seek out the strongest. Leave only carnage in your wake.

Included with this Skin are:
• 4 color variants
• Profile Card Background, Title, Badge, and Profile Card Frame as additional cosmetics
